node: Transformer component supply chain: CTC magnet wire, cores, insulation, bushings, tap changers, and specialized subcomponents
summary: Expanded the transformer-component node into a compact US-listed universe. The strongest direct public-market mappings found in this pass are Hubbell for transformer bushings and related utility apparatus, DuPont for Nomex transformer insulation, Cleveland-Cliffs for grain-oriented electrical steel exposure to transformer cores, and Hammond Power Solutions as an OTC-listed transformer OEM/direct customer anchor with possible component-chain sensitivity. Evidence quality is mixed: Hubbell and DuPont have direct product-page evidence; Cleveland-Cliffs has annual-report evidence for transformer/electrical-steel linkage but requires product-mix verification; Hammond is included as a speculative OTC exception based on external context and should be verified with primary filings.
